data.body: Live confirmation on bedrock (REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1, main @ 8a036765705): dense-completion trials 3/3 PASS (banked 5, responses_at_bank [2,5,7,7,7]) and full-file rerun 2 passed in 166s — the reported 0/3 signature no longer reproduces. Root cause was the actor-filtered (source=='tool') observation rejecting intended post-dd41 behavior; fixed by the 0707 eval re-scope to system boundedness in commit af3ea35617f (ticket 6543-24a7, operator-ruled). One transient error appeared in a single earlier rerun and did not reproduce in two immediate follow-ups (single-test + full-file) — consistent with live-canary throttling, distinct signature from this report. Closing as duplicate of 6543.
